meta.name: emails
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated email flow, or lifecycle email program. Also use when the user mentions "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," "lifecycle emails," "trigger-based emails," "email funnel," "email workflow," "what emails should I send," "welcome series," or "email cadence." Use this for any multi-email automated flow. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For in-app onboarding, see onboarding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并优化自动发信的邮件序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让客户在关键时刻自动收到你的邮件
copy.tagline_en: Design automated email sequences for key moments.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want customers to automatically receive your emails at key moments.

howto.what: Claude 会先读取产品营销上下文，再为用户设计多封邮件的自动发送序列，给出每封邮件的发送时机、主题行、预览文本、正文和行动按钮，并规划整体触发条件与目标。
howto.when: 当用户提到“email sequence”“drip campaign”“nurture sequence”等关键词，或要求创建/优化任何多邮件自动化流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个5封邮件的欢迎新用户系列。
我想做一个流失用户挽回的自动化邮件流程。
把我们的转化邮件改成自动化的生命周期邮件。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an email marketing expert. It first reads product marketing context if available, then designs multi-email automated sequences, specifying for each email the send timing, subject line, preview text, body copy, and CTA, plus overall triggers and goals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "email sequence," "drip campaign," or "nurture sequence," or asks to create or optimize any multi-email automated flow.

say_en.text: Design a 5-email welcome sequence for new users.
Create a win-back email flow for inactive users.
Turn our conversion emails into automated lifecycle emails.
